scenario.name: m3_wash_clog
scenario.description: Closed loop with the mesh clogging from wash 2: pressure climbs, alert, back-flush, re-plan, recovery. Clog growth rescaled by 0.50 when the trap went to a single 0.3 mm etch depth and its volume changed from 7.35 to 14.7 uL; the fault is per microlitre pushed.

events.narration: Load 10,000 capsules through the top inlet; they settle in a single layer behind the weir.
events.explanation: Fastest safe option of 3 simulated (0 rejected): load 14.7 uL at 40 uL/min, predicted 22 s, 63.2% exchanged, peak 2.00 kPa.

events.narration: Wash 2 x 39.7 uL (the volume of three 20 uL washes, cut to fit the chamber): buffer flows past the weir to waste while the capsules stay behind it.
events.explanation: Fastest safe option of 16 simulated (7 rejected): exchange 3 x 39.7 uL wash_buffer at 40 uL/min + 29 s soak, predicted 208 s, 100.0% exchanged, peak 2.00 kPa.
